title: Expand Phase 2 pool admission

findings.finding: Missing pool cap test in _build_pool_from_archive. The test file docstring mentions the pool cap but no test verifies the sort-by-deployability_rank_score-and-slice behavior, nor the no-op path when len(pool) < PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES.
findings.fix: Add a test that constructs synthetic pool entries with known deployability_rank_score ordering, calls _build_pool_from_archive with PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=3, and asserts only the top-3 remain ordered by score descending. Also test with a pool smaller than the cap to verify no-op.

findings.finding: _raw_feasibility_violation_score does not check drawdown. The new per-fold DD gate in _passes_pool_admission_impl is not mirrored in _raw_feasibility_violation_score, so passes_evolution_deployability_preview can return True for rules with high DD that would later fail pool admission.
findings.fix: Add DD checks to _raw_feasibility_violation_score when cv_fold=True and _split_mode_is_purged_cv(), consistent with the admission function. Non-blocking; evolution preview is documented as lightweight.

findings.finding: No train-side DD rejection test. test_phase2_pool_admission.py only tests val-side DD rejection.
findings.fix: Add a test case where train DD exceeds PHASE2_CV_MAX_WORST_DD (e.g., 25%) but val DD is within bounds (e.g., 8%).

findings.finding: Positive-good gate rejection not tested. test_positive_good_does_not_crash_on_valid_rule only verifies the gate doesn't crash; no test verifies actual rejection when a rule passes relaxed CV thresholds but fails gate_positive_good (e.g., train_pf=0.85 < 1.0).
findings.fix: Add a test where relaxed CV thresholds pass (val_ret=-5%, DD=10%) but train_pf=0.85 < PHASE3_MIN_TRAIN_PF=1.0 → assert False.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria met. Implementation correctly relaxes CV per-fold pool admission thresholds (val return >= -8%, PF >= 0.80, DD <= 18%, trades >= 10) while keeping the holdout path strict. Pool capped at PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=140 sorted by deployability_rank_score. PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD=True gate runs as secondary check after relaxed CV thresholds. All 31 relevant tests pass (10 new + 21 patched). Two existing test files patched minimally (1 line each) to disable positive-good for legacy-format tests. Four non-blocking findings flagged for test coverage improvements.
